title: Online Tag: late guest poses no longer drop the ball
summary: In online Tag rooms the host treated a guest whose poses were more than a second late as wrecked, so a guest carrier on a slow or busy link kept losing the ball before scoring. The host now holds a late rider at its last position for up to 3 s before treating it as absent.
details: Verified: multiplayer_tag relay browser test passes twice (the host held 69 and 95 late steps that previously would have dropped the ball), multiplayer_hockey and split_tag pass.
limitation: Verified on a local relay on the host only, not production.
